csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Plainfield is soliciting proposals from consultants experienced in developing several options in a Comprehensive Facilities Plan that will guide the Town in producing a dynamic master plan for all major facility improvements, including renovations, consolidations, repurposing, additions, or new construction, over the next 10 years. The plan will provide an analysis and appraisal of present and future needs in relation to all facilities. The facilities included in the plan are: Police Department- 210 Norwich Rd, Plainfield, CT Highway Garage, Animal Control, Bus Garage Office- Unity Drive, Moosup, CT Senior Center and Recreation Center- 482 Norwich Rd, Plainfield, CT Early Childhood Center- 651 Norwich Rd, Plainfield, CT WPCA- 26 Black Hill Rd, Central Village, CT. All the above-mentioned facilities in Plainfield should be surveyed to identify deficiencies that may have an impact on employees, residents, or future growth. A specific survey of each building should include: 1. The present utilization of facilities, facility capacities; sites, and available space with special attention to any needed update of building capacities. 2. A five-year plan for capital improvements addressing the highest priorities.
csv_disciplines_requested: Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning

title: Consultant for Plainfield Owned Buildings
short_description: Consulting services for a municipal facilities master plan covering multiple town-owned buildings.
project_scope: Preparation of a comprehensive facilities plan and dynamic 10-year master plan for major improvements to multiple Town of Plainfield facilities, including analysis of present and future needs, surveys of deficiencies, utilization and capacity assessments, site and space review, and development of options for renovations, consolidations, repurposing, additions, or new construction. Facilities listed are Police Department at 210 Norwich Rd, Highway Garage/Animal Control/Bus Garage Office on Unity Drive in Moosup, Senior Center and Recreation Center at 482 Norwich Rd, Early Childhood Center at 651 Norwich Rd, and WPCA at 26 Black Hill Rd in Central Village.
services: Consulting services for land use planning, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, facility assessment, capacity analysis, and capital improvement planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a facilities master planning and assessment assignment, not structural or bridge design.
- Disciplines requested are land use planning, master planning, and redevelopment planning.
- No specific structural engineering, long-span, bridge, roof, or special structure component is described.
- Falls under pure planning/consulting scope, which is generally not relevant for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender documents. The scope covers planning for potential renovations, additions, repurposing, consolidations, and new construction across several municipal facilities over 10 years, but no quantified capital program is provided.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is a planning/master planning consultancy without stated construction cost, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Consultants must be experienced in developing several options within a comprehensive facilities plan for municipal buildings. No detailed minimum reference counts or formal qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Town of Plainfield, Connecticut. Contact: Kevin M. Cunningham. Email: kcunninghamselectman@plainfieldct.org. Phone: 860-230-3005. Website: https://portal.ct.gov/das/ctsource/bidboard?language=en_USs
notes: Project number 37630; Project #868591; ProjectID 1014042. Mandatory pre-submittal meeting on 07/13/2026 at 10:00 AM EDT at Early Childhood Center, 651 Norwich Rd, Plainfield, CT. Contract participation goal: 25% SB and 6.25% MWDOB. Although multiple buildings are involved, the procurement is for strategic facilities planning rather than building or structural design.
